g.text: Agreement and accuracy are different outcomes
One point per observed group, averaging its tasks. Both axes compare the same respondents before and after revision.
Left means estimates became more similar. Down means the full-group mean became more accurate.

a.text: Source: Becker, Brackbill & Centola (2017) | doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1615978114 | Reanalysis: 28 Sep 2026

g.text: All 34 observed groups are shown. Group membership, task mix and the released initial-response scale stay fixed between rounds.
Descriptive paired changes; the score is squared error, so this does not reproduce the paper's reported absolute-error effect sizes.
